n1.speaker: ellis
n1.text: Thank you for bringing the form back. Did you have to ask Leslie to sign it?

translations.fa: ممنون که فرم را برگردوندید. مجبور شدید از لزلی بخواید امضاش کنه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I had to wait until she got home.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، مجبور شدم صبر کنم تا بیاد خونه.

branches.suggestion: No, I didn't have to — Tom signed it.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، لازم نشد — تام امضاش کرد.

n2.speaker: ellis
n2.text: Perfect. On the last trip, the parents had to provide a packed lunch. This time lunch is included.

translations.fa: عالیه. تو اردوی قبلی، والدین مجبور بودن ناهار بسته‌بندی‌شده بدن. این بار ناهار شامل میشه.

branches.suggestion: Great. What do the children need to bring?

cultureNote.en: A "packed lunch" (UK) is a lunch you bring from home — Americans say "bag lunch" or "sack lunch".
cultureNote.fa: packed lunch ناهاری است که از خانه می‌آورید.

n3.speaker: ellis
n3.text: Just wellies and a waterproof coat. Last year it poured, and we had to come back early.

translations.fa: فقط چکمهٔ لاستیکی و کت ضدآب. پارسال بارون شدید اومد و مجبور شدیم زود برگردیم.

branches.suggestion: Oh no. Were the children upset?
I'll make sure she has her wellies.

cultureNote.en: "Wellies" (wellington boots) are rubber boots — a British essential for muddy trips.

n4.speaker: ellis
n4.text: They loved the mud, actually! But we needed parent volunteers to help. Would you be able to come along?

translations.fa: راستش عاشق گل شدن! ولی به داوطلب از والدین نیاز داشتیم. می‌تونید همراهمون بیاید؟

branches.suggestion: I'd love to. What would I have to do?
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی دوست دارم. باید چی کار کنم؟

n5.speaker: ellis
n5.text: Good question — you'd need a DBS check first. Last time a dad didn't have one, so he had to stay on the coach!

translations.fa: سؤال خوبیه — اول باید بررسی DBS داشته باشید. دفعهٔ قبل یه پدر نداشت، پس مجبور شد تو اتوبوس بمونه!

branches.suggestion: How long does a DBS check take?
I'll apply for one this week.

cultureNote.en: A DBS check is a UK criminal record check needed to work or volunteer with children.
cultureNote.fa: DBS بررسی سوابق کیفری برای کار با کودکان است.

n6.speaker: ellis
n6.text: Usually a couple of weeks. I'll send you the link. Nicola will be thrilled you're coming!

translations.fa: معمولاً دو هفته. لینکش را براتون می‌فرستم. نیکولا خیلی ذوق می‌کنه که شما میاید!
